summary: SURVIVES_NARROWED. Predecessor 6407f72 remains open in-context-induction/control plumbing only. Successor 18480949 is a materially stronger, falsifiable context-reset retention protocol, but it is not yet evidence of persistent model learning.

evidence.independent_pack_checks: 56 episodes; six records each; retained/no_acquisition prompts identical; both support-free; answer key eval-only; wrong token differs; external-memory support explicit
evidence.accepted_objection_1: selftest stateless_support_parser_retained_accuracy_zero is blank-output construction, not executed parser accuracy
evidence.accepted_objection_2: HARD_CONTEXT_RESET establishes prompt-context reset only, not process/reopened-session persistence
evidence.accepted_objection_3: mechanism runner must enforce fresh pre-update state isolation between clean/shuffled updates, episodes, and mechanism arms
evidence.metadata_hazard: pack records retain family_id/condition metadata; inference wrapper must send prompt only and not expose answer key/repo retrieval

next_action: C may proceed with CPU/source-only mechanism wrappers, but must: allowlist prompt-only model input; execute real no-acquisition/stateless controls rather than blank synthetic zero; reset/verify identical pre-update state per arm/episode; separate context-reset retention from process/reopen persistence and add reload retest before durable-persistence language. A may consume 18480949 as experimental protocol plumbing only, not learning evidence. B next reviews A3 V2 unless fresher coordination reprioritizes.
